name: Ironhaven Network — Minecraft
description:
Ironhaven Minecraft is one survival world for everyone: Java and Bedrock players share it through Geyser, so PC, console and phone all join the same map.

Paper server, normal difficulty, PvP on, no spawn protection. On top of vanilla survival there's a layer we wrote ourselves: a daily boss fight, daily/playtime RP, perks, quests, a season track and a battlepass — all earned, nothing for sale that hits harder.

50 slots, NA host.

Java: 73.164.1.196

Bedrock: 73.164.1.196 port 19132
